title: Evaluating LLM Outputs — Combine Several Kinds of Judge
key_insight: Use deterministic checks for facts and structure, rubric-based model graders for scale, and humans for calibration and high-impact ambiguity.
body:
## Combine Several Kinds of Judge

Exact matching works for IDs but unfairly rejects good summaries. Human review is nuanced but slow.

Use deterministic checks for facts and structure, rubric-based model graders for scale, and humans for calibration and high-impact ambiguity.

Blind model names during comparison. Randomize answer order so presentation does not decide the result.
common_mistakes: One fluent sample proves production quality.
All good summaries must exactly match one sentence.
A model grader is a permanent ground truth.
mini_exercise: Draw “Combine Several Kinds of Judge” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Repeatable output evaluation catches quality regressions and separates plausible language from task success.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Combine Several Kinds of Judge” to explain Evaluating LLM Outputs plainly.
